calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS line_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, MIN(f.sale_date) AS mn, MAX(f.sale_date) AS mx, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS loaded, SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT 'rpt' AS src, SUM(receipts) AS receipts, SUM(units_sold) AS units, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS gross_net, SUM(returns_net) AS ret, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact', COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), SUM(f.quantity), SUM(f.net_amount), NULL, NULL, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
